verdict.rationale: Docs state each workspace gets 'auto-generated documentation' for its REST/GraphQL API with an 'interactive playground where you can execute real calls' (twenty-docs-8, twenty-docs-61), strongly implying OpenAPI/Swagger-style spec generation, but there is no explicit confirmation of a downloadable machine-readable spec file or its format. A probe for common OpenAPI paths on the docs site returned 404s, though this checked the static docs domain rather than a live workspace's generated docs endpoint, so it's inconclusive rather than a clear contradiction. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a downloadable/exportable OpenAPI JSON/YAML file, confirmation of format (OpenAPI vs proprietary), and independent verification that the per-workspace docs are machine-readable/importable.
